about.title: About us
about.description: 3legant is a gift and decoration store. About us, what we value, and how we work.
about.lead: We sell things for the home — not the ones that catch the eye, but the ones people use every day and keep for years.
about.story1: 3legant started in 2019 as a small shop. Then as now, one question decides everything: will this still be wanted in five years? If the answer is no, it does not go in the catalog.
about.story2: Today the catalog covers furniture, lighting and home decor. We pick every category ourselves and work directly with the maker, which is how both the price and the quality stay ours to answer for.
about.value1Text: Natural materials and plain shapes. Trends pass; the object stays.
about.value2Text: No middlemen. The price covers the object and the delivery, nothing else.
about.value3Text: A person from the shop answers your question — not a bot, and during working hours.

about.ctaText: From furniture to lighting, all in one place.
